import 'dart:async';

import 'package:hazard_fixture/pending.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  var ticks = 0;

  test('starts something and does not wait for it', () {
    unawaited(later(4));
    // Never cancelled: it ticks through the tests after this one.
    every(const Duration(milliseconds: 5), () => ticks++);
    expect(seen, 0);
  });

  test('the answer arrives during a later test', () async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 80));
    expect(seen, 8);
    expect(ticks, greaterThan(2));
  });

  test('ticksIn', () {
    expect(ticksIn(100, 20), 5);
    expect(ticksIn(100, 0), 0);
  });
}
